spans.s: SV0096 एककाल भोजन ekakāla bhojana Food should be given once a day in order to stimulate digestive fire. In certain condition to ignite the digestive fire in Agnimandy condition, this process of having meal per day is adopted.
AT0109 एकदंष्ट्रार्दित ekadaṁṣṭrārdita If bitten by poisonous frog (toad), then there will be the mark of only one fang.
DG0079 एकदेशसाध्यत्व ekadeśasādhyatva Different parts different effects; properties & actions are specific to the part of the substance;
BK0041 एकपिण्डम् ekapiṇḍam Making the material in homogenous mass by the process of grinding , rubbing, pounding 2.in the form of solid doses
BK0042 एकवासरः ekavāsaraḥ the preparations or medicated oil & gudpaka etc. are advised not to process in a single day
BP0099 एकान्तः ekāntaḥ Statements which are absolute, not differing from context to context and could not be modified.
